title: Under The Hood
use_cases: Use when building a local knowledge graph from web content scraped via Firecrawl
Configure when requiring fast analytical storage with DuckDB and vector retrieval
Implement when local semantic embedding is needed on port 8765
Use when clustering related documents using USearch area codes
Implement when batch processing large datasets using the batch_ingest.sh pipeline
content:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  You + Claude (vibing)               │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Firecrawl MCP                       │
│  → Scrape web content                │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Claude Analysis                     │
│  → Extract learnings & insights      │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Semantic Embedding                  │
│  → 384-dim vectors (local, warm)     │

└──────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Clustering                          │
```

**Key Files:**

- `kg` - Main CLI (use this for everything!)
- `kg_production.py` - Core KG system
- `kg_models.py` - Type-safe interfaces
- `embedding_service.py` - Warm embedding server
- `batch_ingest.sh` - Batch processing pipeline
